AVISOS DE TERCEIROS / THIRD-PARTY NOTICES

Gerado por scripts/third-party-notices.mjs para x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.
Generated for x86_64-pc-windows-msvc from locked Cargo and npm packages.

Escopo: inventário conservador de código-fonte de dependências de execução,
compilação e desenvolvimento, identificadas separadamente. A presença de um
pacote de ferramenta não significa que seu executável esteja no aplicativo.
Inclui avisos originais disponíveis nas árvores de fontes e complementos
verificados nos commits originais e a libopus. Drivers externos, como o
OpenGL da placa de vídeo, são componentes separados do sistema.

Scope: conservative source-package inventory covering runtime, build and
development dependencies, labeled separately. Build-tool packages do not
imply their executables are shipped. Original license/notice files retain
their copyright and terms; translations are not substituted for originals.
This file does not relicense third-party code or select a different license
for composite SPDX expressions. See dependencies.json for sources and hashes.

VB-CABLE is not distributed. Windows, Rust/Node/CMake toolchains and system
runtimes are not relicensed by this project. This inventory covers the locked
package source trees and the explicitly identified bundled native components;
it is not an inventory of every tool installed on the build machine.

No missing original license documents identified within this inventory.
